title: France's Mistral launches AI model it says outperforms some Chinese rivals
key_facts: Mistral AI released Mistral Large 4 (nicknamed Le Chonk), a multimodal model with 1 trillion parameters, on Tuesday 6 Oct 2026.
It is not open-weight yet: access is through a public guardrail endpoint, with weights planned in about three weeks after safety testing.
Mistral says it trained the model on its own compute using 4,000 Nvidia GPUs, which VP Science Pierre Stock called two to three times fewer than Chinese competitors.
Benchmark results are still pending; Mistral hopes it will be best among open-weight models outside China and may beat closed models in areas such as cybersecurity, finance and chip design.
Mistral's Series D last month, led by Samsung, valued it at 21 billion euros; ASML led the Series C.
quote_evidence: On Tuesday, French AI lab Mistral AI released Mistral Large 4 (ML4), a new large multimodal model aiming to leapfrog both American and Chinese rivals.
With benchmark results still pending, Mistral hopes ML4 will be best in class among open-weight models, especially outside of China.
Mistral plans to make its weights available in just three weeks, after safety testing is complete.
why_it_matters_hint: A Western lab is offering a very large model it plans to open up, as an alternative to Chinese open models and closed US ones.
notes: Reuters page blocked (401); read TechCrunch. Reuters headline says it outperforms some Chinese rivals; TechCrunch says benchmarks are pending, so this is a company claim.
